description: Acuvim II series power and energy meters (V3 firmware map), RS485 Modbus RTU and Modbus TCP with the Ethernet module
source: Accuenergy, "Acuvim II V3 Modbus map" v1.10 (2026-09-25)
notes: Acuvim II, IIR, IIE and IIW meters with the V3 Modbus map. FC03 reads, FC10 writes; FC01/FC05 for the relay outputs.
Values are big endian, high word first; floats are IEEE 754 and given in primary units (V, A, kW, kvar, kVA).
Energies are counts of 0.1 kWh (kvarh, kVAh) with Energy display mode (0x1019) at Primary, the default; in Secondary mode they are counts of 0.001 kWh.
Some I/O, analog and alarm registers need the matching AXM-IO extension module.

The integer real-time copies, the high-speed (100 ms, 20 ms) blocks, harmonic amplitudes and phases, time stamps of max/min values, alarm and SOE records, data logs, the TOU program and holidays, waveform capture and the Class S aggregations are in the Modbus map and left out here.
